disclaimer: Conceptual/engineering plan within physical limits; does not claim infinite or perpetual energy.

structure.goal: Sustained continuous abundant energy supply in Earth/near-Earth space (asymptotic, not physically infinite)
physics_constraints: No infinite/perpetual energy source; conservation of energy and thermodynamic limits apply.
Solar flux near Earth ~1361 W/m^2 sets practical harvest ceiling per area; conversion/storage/transmission incur losses.
Sustainment requires maintenance, redundancy, and replenishment over system lifetime.

elements: Space segment: modular solar power satellites (LEO/MEO/GEO) with high-efficiency PV and power beaming.
Ground segment: rectennas + terrestrial renewables (solar/wind) + grid interface.
Storage/firming: battery arrays, regenerative fuel cells, and power routing for duty-cycle smoothing.
Control: autonomous health monitoring, power scheduling, and fault-tolerant routing.

components.name: Modular PV arrays
components.role: Primary energy harvest in space (high-duty illumination in suitable orbits)
components.notes: Deployable thin-film or multi-junction panels; modular for incremental scaling.

components.name: Wireless power transmission
components.role: Beam energy to receivers (microwave or laser, per safety/regulatory)
components.notes: Phased-array transmitters; strict beam safety, pointing, and spill control.

components.name: Rectenna/receiver sites
components.role: Receive and rectify beamed power to usable electrical output
components.notes: Ground or platform receivers sized to beam and demand.

components.name: Energy storage
components.notes: Li-ion/LFP batteries, regenerative fuel cells; sized for continuity targets.

components.name: In-space assembly/servicing
components.role: Deploy, maintain, repair, and upgrade modules
components.notes: Robotic servicing, modular replacement to sustain output over decades.

components.name: Thermal management
components.role: Radiators/heat rejection for conversion and electronics
components.notes: Critical for efficiency and component lifetime.

components.name: Comms & autonomy
components.role: Telemetry, control, beam steering, fault detection/isolation
components.notes: Autonomous operations to reduce latency and ops cost.

fast_feasible_short_term: Start with ground/LEO demos: high-efficiency PV + battery firming + limited beaming pilots.
Use modular, repeatable units (standard buses/interfaces) to compress integration time.
Prioritize COTS components and incremental capacity additions over monolithic builds.
Parallelize: manufacturing, launch cadence, and ground receiver build-out.
optimal: Optimize end-to-end efficiency (harvest, conversion, transmission, rectification, storage round-trip).
Co-optimize orbit, constellation geometry, and receiver siting for duty cycle and demand match.
Design for maintainability (robotic servicing) to maximize lifetime energy return.
Use closed-loop telemetry and predictive maintenance to minimize downtime.
risk_safety_regulatory: Comply with spectrum/beam safety, orbital debris mitigation, and space/ground regulations.
Fail-safe beam cutoff, redundancy, and graceful degradation modes.

phases.name: Pilot (0-2y)
objectives: Demonstrate PV+storage module and safe low-power beaming/rectenna link
Validate PMAD, thermal, autonomy in relevant environment

phases.name: Scale (2-5y)
objectives: Deploy modular constellation/cluster and multiple receivers
Add servicing capability and storage firming for continuity

phases.name: Sustain (5y+)
objectives: Optimize routing, lifetime extension, and cost/kWh reduction

key_metrics.target: sustained high-duty supply within physical limits

integration_hooks.hash_addressed_modeling: Use mathlib times-plank/tree/event-loop and aspen/seed for scenario hashing, scheduling, and auditable state transitions.
integration_hooks.field_relativity: Apply field/relativity correction modules for consistency checks on modeled rates/frames where relevant.
integration_hooks.inspection: Use field_inspect and backtest-style evaluation patterns for parameter sweeps and validation runs.
